heading: Availability of incentive payments for certain producers

tree.heading: Incentive payments required
tree.text: Subject to subsection (b), the Secretary shall make available a total of $20,000,000 of funds of the Commodity Credit Corporation during the 2003 through 2005 crop years to provide incentive payments to producers of hard white wheat.

children.text: only with regard to production that meets minimum quality criteria; and
on not more than 2,000,000 acres or the equivalent volume of production.

tree.heading: Demand for wheat
tree.text: To be eligible to obtain an incentive payment under subsection (a), a producer shall demonstrate to the satisfaction of the Secretary that buyers and end-users are available for the wheat to be covered by the incentive payment.
